'''Palee Ruda''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]]<ref name="DB" /> clubgoer<ref name="Insider" /> [[Coruscanti/Legends|native]] [[Homeworld/Legends|to]]<ref name="DB" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CL">''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="DB" /> During a [[Local day/Legends|night]]<ref name="aotc">{{Film|II}}</ref> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> Ruda visited<ref name="aotc" /> the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]], a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of Coruscant.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> Ruda exited the club<ref name="aotc" /> accompanied by a [[Pacithhip/Legends|Pacithhip]] escort<ref name="Insider" /> and a [[Kajain'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kajain'sa'Nikto]],<ref name="aotc" /> just as the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] ran into the club, trying to escape from the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] after her [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|assassination attempt]] on [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].<ref name="aotc">{{Film|II}}</ref> She unwittingly missed<ref name="Insider" /> Wesell's arm being [[Dismemberment/Legends|dismembered]] by Kenobi.<ref name="aotc" />

Ruda had light skin, [[Color/Legends|blonde]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], and a feminine first name of Human origin.<ref name="GalacticCampaign">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> On that night,<ref name="aotc" /> Ruda, a fashion victim,<ref name="FF96">{{FactFile|96|OUT 1-2|Outlander Nightclub Patrons}}</ref> wore an intimidating ensemble of white face makeup with painted on eyebrows, a breathable chainmail veil,<ref name="Insider" /> a [[Clothing/Legends|top]], and black pants.<ref name="aotc" />

==Behind the scenes==
Palee Ruda first appeared in the [[2002]] [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].<ref name="aotc" /> The Outlander Club exterior scenes, which included Ruda, were shot at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]].<ref name="365Days">''[[Creating the Worlds of Star Wars: 365 Days]]''</ref> Prior to the film's release, she was first pictured<ref name="Insider 51">{{InsiderCite|51|Prequel Update}}</ref> in [[January]] [[2001]]<ref name="Cargo Bay">{{CargoBay|url=item-detail/6174|text=Star Wars Insider #51}}</ref> with the "[[Prequel Update]]" section of the [[Star Wars Insider 51|fifty-first]] issue ''[[Star Wars Insider]]''.<ref name="Insider 51" /> The character was first named in an image in the [[StarWars.com]] article "[[Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases]]," published on [[May 2]], [[2003]].<ref name="crc">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/bts/article/f20030502/index.html|text=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases|int=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases}}</ref>
